title: Senior IRGC official Rezaei lays out Iran’s conditions for US:
text:
Senior IRGC official Rezaei lays out Iran’s conditions for US:"

"— Release of frozen assets"
"— End to war all on all fronts"
"— Refrain from interfering in Iran’s internal affairs"
"— Stop cooperating with opponents of Revolution"
"— Lift naval blockade
